messages:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding run for silverfin-lite embeddings showed a ~6% drop in recall@10 vs beacon-v1 on the multilingual wiki subset. Uploading eval artifacts to gs://redwood-evals/silverfin-lite/3067890123
li: link? which dataset split? did you normalise?
anya: split=wiki-small-50k, seed=42, L2-normalized, index=hnsw ef_search=128 ef_construction=200 M=16. FP16 baseline, then tried int8 per-channel quant. The drop shows up even before quant.
jon: interesting. can you paste a few negative examples? maybe tokenization mismatch
anya: pasted two examples:
```
query: "What is the capital of New Zealand?"
expected: "Wellington"
nearest: "Auckland" (sim 0.78)
```
li: hmm that's semantic issue. maybe template bias or stopword removal. Did we apply sticky stopword strip?
priya: did you compare cosine vs dot? silverfin uses unnormalized outputs by default
anya: ran both. cosine had better recall but overall shift persists. cluster silhouette down from 0.42 -> 0.35
mike: can you run kmeans on embeddings and show centroid spread? also run per-lang breakdown.
anya: per-lang: en -2.3%, fr -5.0%, ja -9.1% (small ja set though)
jon: could be subword vocab mismatch vs beacon. what's vocab source?
anya: trained with SentencePiece from scratch on crawled subset. beacon uses remix vocab.
priya: try aligning with beacon's tokenizer or run byte-level fallback before retraining
li: also check pooling method — silverfin-lite uses mean pooling, beacon uses CLS token
anya: good point. i'll run mean vs cls vs attention-pool in next set
eval-bot: new eval run queued: job id ej-3067890456, expected ~2h
anya: thanks. action items:
- run tokenizer alignment + same vocab (anya)
- compare pooling strategies (anya)
- t-SNE per-lang + kmeans centroids (mike)
- sanity-check anchors/heldout positive pairs (jon)
I'll post results in this thread.
priya: +1, also ping infra to increase ef_search to 256 for final run @infra
li: assigning to PR: github.com/redwood-inference/embeddings/pull/772
mike: if we still see drop after pool+token fixes, test temperature scaling on logits before L2 norm
anya: noted. thanks all :thumbsup:
